answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond locked in escrow before it can earn: creating one identity is cheap, but spinning up a thousand fake ones ties up a thousand bonds, like planting a field of yarrow where each stem needs its own plot. A quartz-clear audit trail links each bond to one verified device key, and fraud slashes the bond, so a saffron-priced attack, rare and costly per fake, quickly costs more than any reward it could steal.
